integrity: The infinite-parameter proof uses two explicitly solved Jacobi Green rows and algebraic factorizations. Symbolic and finite-section checker results are supporting reproducibility evidence, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact global projector norm at a nonunit defect length and global maximizing locations are not established. Theorems concern one cell on the infinite real line only. Specialized historical priority remains subject to external confirmation.
title: One anomalous cell destroys the sharp uniform-mesh spline projection bound
